days.title: Phan Thiet – out to the island
days.morning: About 2.5 – 3 hours by fast boat from Phan Thiet port to Phu Quy.
days.afternoon: Check in, rent a motorbike and swim at Bai Nho beach.

days.title: Linh Son pagoda – Ganh Hang
days.morning: Go up to Linh Son pagoda on Cam mountain for views over the sea and village.
days.afternoon: Walk the Ganh Hang rocks, take photos and wait for sunset.

days.title: Snorkelling at Hon Tranh
days.morning: Boat out to Hon Tranh and snorkel over the coral.
days.afternoon: Swim and relax in a hammock on the islet, then head back.
days.evening: Grilled sea urchin and sun-dried squid.

days.title: Around the island – fishing villages
days.morning: Visit the Van An Thanh whale temple and Thay Nai's tomb.
days.afternoon: Ride around the island past the wind farm and stop for a swim.
days.evening: Stroll the night market and buy dried squid as gifts.

days.title: Back to the mainland
days.morning: Breakfast, then the boat back to Phan Thiet.
days.afternoon: Walk Doi Duong beach, then continue to Mui Ne or Saigon.
